cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's your Tuesday bin duty again. Check the rota before you leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I covered your Thursday last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I covered your Tuesday. Read the swap box: one week only. We're back on our usual days.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because you didn't want my Thursday permanently. Please read the limit as well as the names. Your Tuesday is back.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects the swap duration and A5 selective reading of a requested limit, using rota expertise to prove Tuesday remains B's unwanted duty.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 last Thursday cover causes A3 reciprocal Tuesday and one-week explanation; B4 authorship challenge causes A5 reason B wanted the limit.

relationship.evidence: B2 invokes real effort and B4 suspects self-serving procedure, plausible household negotiation.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 challenge to expose the rule's protective purpose for B and return the duty.

specificity.evidence: A1 B Tuesday and B2 A Thursday now establish a consistent reciprocal swap.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 read-the-limit instruction directly targets B4 challenge and ends on the concrete returned day.
